Package com.example.project3.project2

Class Schedule

java.lang.Object
com.example.project3.util.List<Section>
com.example.project3.project2.Schedule
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<Section>
public class Schedule extends List<Section>
Represents course schedule containing lists of sections Initial capacity of the list is 4, and increases by 4 when the list is full.
